newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil firm, low sulphur busier.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil firm, low sulphur busier.

text.p: High and low sulphur straight-run fuel oil retained a firm tone with Russian material gaining support from thinner availabilities.
One low sulphur straight-run cargo was sold at $140 cif NWE and another went at $141 cif NWE.
A M-100 was sold at $117 cif NWE out of Klaipeda for a prompt loading. Dealers said the water content of Klaipeda cargoes was rising.
An E-4 cargo was sold either today or yesterday at formula +$1-2. In combination with some clearing out last week, E-4 was set to become scarcer. -- Matt Jones, London +44 171 542 8980
